negative_controls.description: Outcome recorder both-states: nonexistent binary and closed port must FAIL; trivial subprocess must SUCCEED. A recorder that reports SUCCEEDED for everything is inert.

Synthetic call-time interceptor DENIES all four undeclared ops (fires on the enforced state). The program state (no interceptor) lets the same four ops SUCCEED. Proves what enforcement would look like and that the program does not have it.
Static scanner must FIRE on a planted file containing tool_permissions and be SILENT on an empty directory. Combined with known-present D2-WORKUNIT-AUTHZ.md, the scanner is not a silent matcher.

On this checkout hooks/ is absent. The probe must NOT claim a populated-hooks zero. Second instrument (posix grep -R / git) must see a known-present file (D2-WORKUNIT-AUTHZ.md) so a silent scanner is distinguishable from a missing tree.
Negative control required by the delivery contract: the harness is not failing everything. Narrow escapes fire; wide declared-and-used ops do not.
